label: D2: chose a1 but rare transition to S2, after an unrewarded trial, while the policy still favours a1
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO). 99.7% of mass is on trials where the agent chose a1, and 98% where the reached state is S2: the a1 -> S2 rare transition. Within that, it needs the previous trial to be unrewarded (prev_reward==0 holds 97% of mass) and the policy logit to still favour a1 moderately (choice in [2.78, 8.07) holds 96% of mass). It never fires after a2 or at S2 reached commonly via a2. Weak activations (~0.15 of max) also show up at a1 -> S1 common D2 steps right after a run of a1 -> S2 rare trials. Magnitude grows over consecutive a1 -> S2 rare unrewarded trials (0.6 -> 0.95 -> 1.0 of max in top windows). It is stronger early in the episode and gone after trial ~85, and it is concentrated where S1 is the hidden good state. All variables in the predicate are observed at D2 (action, reached state, previous reward, the model logit). Dev F1 0.75 (P 0.77, R 0.74, mass recall 0.93). Without the choice condition, a1&S2&prev_reward==0 gives F1 0.61. This is the best observed-only predicate. No future variables were needed.
